simple.meaning: מֵצַר (mêtsar) is a Hebrew word meaning “something tight , i.e. (figuratively) trouble.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מֵצַר (H4712) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 116:3, with occurrences in Psalms, Lamentations.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מֵצַר (H4712) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מֵצַר (H4712) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מֵצַר (mêtsar) / H4712 is traced through Psalms 116:3, Psalms 118:5, Lamentations 1:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
